verdict.rationale: Phaser is a client-side JS library rather than a web service, so its closest machine-readable API description is the full TypeScript definitions shipped in the npm package's types folder, which editors and tools consume automatically. No OpenAPI or Swagger spec exists: all candidate paths returned 404. The probed phaser.io/llms.txt examples API (GET /api/v1/examples/{id}) is described only in prose, with no formal spec. missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/JSON-schema-style spec (e.g. for the examples API or MCP tools), explicit docs presenting the type definitions as a machine-readable spec for agents, and independent corroboration of the definitions' completeness.
